blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) steps up its monitoring of suspected illegal recruitment for overseas military jobs after three Filipinos were intercepted at the Davao International Airport over alleged job offers in Eastern Europe. “Illegal recruiters prey on the hopes of our kababayans (compatriots) by disguising dangerous schemes as opportunities for a better future,” PNP Chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a statement on Tuesday.
